description: utopia-php/database 7.4: Database (collections, attributes, indexes, documents, bulk operations, upserts, increments, relationships, permissions, tenancy, caching, transactions), Document, Query, Operator, DateTime, the helpers and validators, over the PostgreSQL adapter. Phase 1 of 3: the other adapters are waived until phases 2 and 3 convert them.

waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\MariaDB::*: Phase 2: the MariaDB adapter is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\MySQL::*: Phase 2: the MySQL adapter is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\SQLite::*: Phase 2: the SQLite adapter is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\Mongo::*: Phase 3: the MongoDB adapter (and utopia-php/mongo) is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\Memory::*: Phase 2: the Memory adapter is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\Redis::*: Phase 3: the Redis database adapter is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Adapter\\Pool::*: Phase 3: the Pool adapter (over utopia-php/pools) is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Mirror::*: Phase 3: Mirror (two databases kept in step) is not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\Mirroring\\*: Phase 3: the Mirroring filters of Mirror are not converted yet
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\PDO::*: PHP runtime plumbing: a PDO wrapper that reconnects; the Rust adapter owns its tokio-postgres connection (reconnect behaviour is converted with Adapter::reconnect)
waivers.Utopia\\Database\\PDOStatement::*: PHP runtime plumbing: the PDOStatement wrapper of Utopia\Database\PDO
